about: The rulesets, private vulnerability reporting, immutable releases and secret scanning of Thornswood and of the engine fork, ThornswoodRP/skymp (#3683, #3691). A change is a pull request to this file; once it merges, the Desk runs pwsh scripts/deploy/Set-BuildRunners.ps1 -RepoSettings (-Check first), which starts github-admin.yml in the private ops repository, and the box's admin service (scripts/vps/admin/admin.js, repo-settings) makes GitHub match it: each ruleset named here is made or put back by name, one GitHub has that this does not name stops the run and is never deleted, reporting, immutable releases, secret scanning and push protection are switched as each entry says, and where an entry lists collaborators, one GitHub has that the list does not name is taken off and an invitation to one is withdrawn; this only ever takes people off, and one it names who is not there is reported for Patrick to invite by hand. A why is this file's own note and is never sent to GitHub.

repositories.why: Switched on at the flip (#3721, public since 30 Oct 2026, 6:23 PM): GitHub offers private vulnerability reporting, the route SECURITY.md names, only on a public repository, and secret scanning with push protection costs a public repository nothing (#3683). Immutable releases: Patrick on the report page, 26 Oct 2026, 11:46 PM MT (#3287): a published Release's files and tag never change after it is published, and every release step here only fills a draft.
repositories.allow_auto_merge_why: Patrick's A on #5182, 31 Oct 2026: a pull request merges itself once Build check result is green, so nobody waits to press merge. The main ruleset below requires that check and has no bypass, so auto-merge can never merge past red, for the owner either. Each pull request's author turns auto-merge (squash) on when it opens.
repositories.collaborators_why: Everybody besides the owner who may push here, as the team is on 31 Oct 2026. A person who leaves the team is a pull request taking them off this list, and the next run takes them off GitHub. A person who joins is invited by Patrick by hand and then added here.

rulesets.name: release tags
rulesets.why: Patrick's A on q-3721-release-tags, 26 Oct 2026: a v* tag names what a release was built from, so only the admin role may move or delete one. GitHub refused the answer as first written, with GitHub Actions (15368) as a second bypass, with 422 Validation Failed on 31 Oct 2026: a personal repository's ruleset can only be bypassed by its roles, deploy keys and installed apps. So making a v* tag stays open to anyone who can push, which release-tag.yml needs, since it makes the tag with the run's own token and never moves or deletes one.

rulesets.name: main
rulesets.why: Patrick's A on q-3721-main-protection, 26 Oct 2026: admins included, no force push or deletion, and the build check required: the one always-run Build check result job (q-3683-required-check A), since a skipped Launcher builds counts as passing. Active since #3684's history rewrite had its force push (step 7, 31 Oct 2026) and that job runs on every pull request now the repository is public (first passed on #5066, 31 Oct 2026). Test tasks in the pull request (.github/workflows/test-tasks.yml, #5199, the redesign's part 18, 31 Oct 2026) is required beside it: the bot's own post rules read the pull request's test tasks before the merge, so one that the bot would refuse to post is fixed in the body, not found on the issue days after. A pull request is required too (Patrick's yes on q-p20-main-needs-pr, 31 Oct 2026, 7:18 PM, the redesign's part 20): nothing reaches main except through a pull request with its checks, and auto-merge does the merging. No review is required (0 approvals), because the checks are the gate and nobody waits to press approve. Nothing in the repository pushes straight to main (searched 1 Nov 2026).

required_status_checks.context: Test tasks in the pull request

repositories.collaborators_why: The fork's collaborators as GitHub had them on 31 Oct 2026, written down so that anybody given push here by hand and not added to this list is taken off at the next run.

rulesets.name: thornswood/engine-changes: pull request, green build, no force push or deletion
rulesets.why: Patrick's A on q-3556-fork-protection, 26 Oct 2026 (#3556, #3691): the two jobs a pull request runs in thornswood-pr-windows.yml are required. No bypass: the lanes push under Patrick's own account.

rulesets.name: main: pull request, no force push or deletion
